learning_outcomes.text: Explain the fundamental concepts of mechanisms, kinematic pairs, degrees of freedom, and kinematic chains.
Perform position, velocity, and acceleration analyses of planar mechanisms using graphical and analytical methods.
Evaluate force, moment, friction, and inertia effects in mechanisms through static/dynamic analysis.
Design/synthesize mechanisms such as four-bar linkages, cams, and gear trains for given motion requirements.
Solve mechanism design and analysis problems individually or in teams, and report and present the results.

syllabus_topics: The basic concepts: To understand to kinematic couples
Mechanism, kinematic diagram and kinematic chain. Mobility of mechanisms.
Loop closure equations and position analysis of mechanisms
Velocity and acceleration analysis of mechanisms.
Velocity and acceleration analysis of mechanisms. Analytical solutions.
Velocity and acceleration analysis of mechanisms. Numerical solutions.
Velocity and acceleration analysis of mechanisms. Numerical solutions.
Velocity and acceleration analysis of mechanisms, the comparison of analytical and numerical solution.
Cam mechanisms: Types and Designs of cam mechanisms.
